description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Monaragala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. R.M. Pasan Sri Bandara Rathnayake, who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent in the Administrative District of Monaragala, has retired from the Public Service after service on 2025-08-20. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. A.G. Nishantha, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as an Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to the vacant post of District Secretary/Government Agent of Monaragala, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
